customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
**Non-negotiable:** no unreviewed low-confidence signal ever reaches a client.

This is the first gate in Argus that a *person* has to clear, and the first thing in the system that can stop a report going out.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
The blocked state. Nothing publishes while the queue has unreviewed items in it.

**This is new behaviour for Argus.** Every other deadline in this system resolves by shipping something degraded — stale data, missing sentiment, a four-of-five run. This one resolves by not shipping at all, and it waits on a human being.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
The run refreshes the data; the calendar decides what goes out.

- **Signals Digest** — daily
- **Weekly Brief** — Monday morning
- **Risk Deep-Dive** — first business day of the month

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip: PDF today, and regretted — nobody can link to a section.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
Once out, out. A rerun never reissues one.

Which has a consequence worth staring at: a signal approved *after* a report published has nowhere to go. The report that should have carried it is already frozen.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip: The party the whole gate exists for. Argus's only outside audience, and the reason 'unvetted' is a word in this design.
